description: This bar chart, titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Human Evaluated Benchmarks,” visually compares the performance of two models—“Llama” (blue bars) and “Ours (Iterative)” (orange bars)—across eight distinct datasets and metrics, which are labeled along the horizontal axis: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled “Score (%)”, is scaled linearly from 0 to 80, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 10 percentage points. Each dataset is represented by a pair of adjacent bars, with the blue bar indicating the score for the Llama model and the orange bar for the “Ours (Iterative)” model. The bars are sorted in descending order of the highest score for each dataset, starting with ARC (where both models score above 80%) and ending with Chat-Arena-Hard (where the Llama score is approximately 70% and the “Ours (Iterative)” score is approximately 75%). In most cases, the orange bars are taller than the blue bars, indicating superior performance for “Ours (Iterative)”. For example, in ARC, the “Ours (Iterative)” score is approximately 85%, while the Llama score is approximately 83%. In contrast, in HumanEval, the Llama score is approximately 70% while the “Ours (Iterative)” score is approximately 75%. The chart does not show any bars with special visual emphasis such as shading or outlines, and the legend in the top right corner clearly distinguishes the two model types by color.
